import json, ast, os

d = json.load(open('impl-plan.json', encoding='utf-8'))
tasks = d['tasks']
ids = [t['id'] for t in tasks]
assert len(ids) == len(set(ids)), 'duplicate ids'

# DAG check: dependsOn references only existing ids, no self-ref, no cycles
id_set = set(ids)
graph = {t['id']: t['dependsOn'] for t in tasks}
for tid, deps in graph.items():
    for dep in deps:
        assert dep in id_set, f'{tid} depends on unknown {dep}'
        assert dep != tid, f'{tid} self-reference'

# cycle check via DFS
visited = {}
def visit(n, stack):
    if n in stack:
        raise AssertionError(f'cycle at {n}')
    if visited.get(n):
        return
    stack.add(n)
    for dep in graph[n]:
        visit(dep, stack)
    stack.discard(n)
    visited[n] = True
for n in ids:
    visit(n, set())
print('DAG OK, no cycles')

# milestone terminal node check
milestone_ids = [t['id'] for t in tasks if t['unitType'] == 'milestone']
print('milestones:', milestone_ids)
for t in tasks:
    for dep in t['dependsOn']:
        assert dep not in milestone_ids or t['id'] in milestone_ids, f'{t[\"id\"]} depends on milestone {dep} -- milestone not terminal'
# stricter: nothing should depend on a milestone at all
for t in tasks:
    for dep in t['dependsOn']:
        assert dep not in milestone_ids, f'{t[\"id\"]} (non-check) depends on milestone {dep}'
print('milestone terminal OK')

# ownedBoundary non-overlap + protected boundary exclusion
protected_prefixes = ['.claude/', 'docs/solution-design.md', 'docs/']
all_paths = []
for t in tasks:
    for p in t['ownedBoundary']:
        assert not p.startswith('..'), p
        assert not os.path.isabs(p), p
        for pp in protected_prefixes:
            assert not p.startswith(pp), f'{t[\"id\"]} touches protected {p}'
        all_paths.append((t['id'], p))

def is_ancestor(a, b):
    # is a an ancestor dir of b (or equal)?
    an = a.rstrip('/').split('/')
    bn = b.rstrip('/').split('/')
    return an == bn[:len(an)]

for i in range(len(all_paths)):
    for j in range(len(all_paths)):
        if i == j: continue
        tid_a, pa = all_paths[i]
        tid_b, pb = all_paths[j]
        if tid_a == tid_b: continue
        assert not is_ancestor(pa, pb), f'{tid_a}:{pa} overlaps {tid_b}:{pb}'
print('ownedBoundary non-overlap + protected-exclusion OK')

import re
